window.operator: native integrals prorated within partial steps; inventory linearly interpolated between accepted states; other samples use step-end rectangles
window.qualification: partial-step closure checks this interpolation, not an independently evolved state

budgets.scale_definition: inventory/transport scale with sqrt(mass * total energy) momentum reference

exit_numerical_force.definition: top-face numerical axial momentum flux minus ambient pressure times exit area

exit_cell_force_estimate.definition: step-end cell-centre estimate; rectangle-rule time average, not the RK numerical face flux

annulus_exit_effective_isp.definition: annulus-exit effective Isp: exit impulse / (net injected mass in same window * g0); not whole-engine Isp

pressure_stations.definition: step-end circumferential means, weighted by interval overlap

chemical_conversion.definition: q times reacted-mass source; internal conversion, not an extra total-energy source

engine_torque.reason: no wall-traction model; angular conservation residual is not engine torque

physical_validation: not established by this report; transient window, no steady-state or sustained-detonation classification

experimental_comparison.source: Mundt2023.pdf: Tables 2-1, 2-2, 3-2 and 4-1; audited in docs/verification/mundt_model_audit.md
experimental_comparison.qualification: transient reduced-model vs experimental long-window mean; nominal case identity only, not validation

measured_thrust.reason: Mundt Run 937 has no measured thrust target

radial_physics.qualification: surface (theta,z) model; cylindrical display is not 3D or the full proposed 2.5D tier

pressure_spectrum.qualification: fewer than three cycles: peak is poorly constrained; pressure oscillation only; interpolation cannot undo aliasing; harmonics need front/reaction inspection
